privacySection1Body: We collect account details, authentication data, learning progress, purchases, certificates, XP, coins, activity records, and technical logs needed to operate CodeBuddies.
privacySection2Body: We use data to provide courses, lessons, dashboards, certificates, rankings, subscriptions, support, fraud prevention, product analytics, and platform security.
privacySection3Body: Payment details may be processed by billing providers such as Paddle. CodeBuddies stores payment status, subscription state, certificate access, and related transaction references, not full card details.
privacySection4Body: You may request account support, correction, or deletion where legally available. Some records may be retained for tax, dispute, security, or audit reasons.
privacySection5Body: We use authentication, role checks, and operational safeguards to protect user accounts. No online service can guarantee absolute security.
privacySection6Body: CodeBuddies is an education platform. If a school, parent, or organization manages access, additional institutional rules may apply.
termsSection1Body: CodeBuddies accounts are personal to the registered user. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for activity performed through your account.
termsSection2Title: 2. Courses, Lessons, XP, Coins, and Achievements
termsSection2Body: Learning progress, XP, coins, streaks, rankings, achievements, and certificates are platform features designed to support education. CodeBuddies may correct clearly erroneous balances or records when needed to protect platform integrity.
termsSection3Body: Premium plans may unlock additional courses, features, certificate eligibility, or other paid benefits. Subscription access remains available while the subscription is active and paid through the supported billing provider.
termsSection4Body: Certificates may require course completion, identity/account validation, premium eligibility, or individual certificate purchase. CodeBuddies may revoke certificates obtained through abuse, fraud, or policy violations.
termsSection5Body: Do not abuse authentication, bypass payments, scrape private data, attack the service, harass users, upload malicious content, or misrepresent your achievements.
termsSection6Body: Refund requests are handled under the Refund Policy. Billing providers such as Paddle may also apply their own transaction, tax, and dispute rules.
termsClosingPrefix: Questions about these terms can be sent through CodeBuddies support. Review our
refundSection1Body: Subscription refunds are reviewed case by case and may depend on billing provider rules, renewal timing, account usage, and applicable consumer protection law.
refundSection2Body: If premium access has been substantially used during the billing period, CodeBuddies may decline or prorate a refund where permitted.
refundSection3Body: Certificate purchases are generally refundable only before the certificate is issued or when duplicate/fraudulent billing is verified.
refundSection4Body: Contact CodeBuddies support with the account email, order date, product purchased, and reason for the request. Paddle or another billing provider may process the final transaction reversal.
refundSection5Body: Accounts involved in payment abuse, unauthorized resale, or fraudulent disputes may lose premium access, certificate access, or platform access.
